items.question: Under what dietary condition must one consume only hot ghee for three days in this observance?
premises: The observance prescribes eating hot ghee for three days.
The observance further prescribes eating only that for three days.
The particle yadā marks this as a specific stage or condition.
items.inference: A defined stage of the observance requires consuming only hot ghee for a three-day period.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between tryahaṃ and tridinaṃ is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
The agreement and precise construal of soṣṇā and kevala depend on the broader passage context.
items.plain_english: When prescribed, one should eat hot ghee for three days, and for three days eat only that.
